findings.title: Sitemap Discovery
findings.evidence: Sitemap request returned status 404, expected 200. Observed: [GET sitemap.xml] status_code: 404

suggested_action.summary: Provide a valid sitemap.xml accessible at the site root.

findings.title: AI Bot Blocking via robots.txt
findings.evidence: robots.txt returned status 404, expected 200. Observed: [GET robots.txt] status_code: 404

suggested_action.summary: Provide a valid robots.txt accessible at the site root.

findings.title: Meta Description Presence
findings.evidence: Page is missing a meta description tag. Observed: [<head> > <meta name='description'>] description: None, length: 0

suggested_action.summary: Add a concise meta description summarizing the page content.

findings.title: Discoverable Internal Links
findings.evidence: No discoverable internal links were found in the HTML anchors. Observed: [<a href> tags] internal_link_count: 0, external_link_count: 1, js_nav_link_count: 0

suggested_action.summary: Expose internal site pages via standard HTML anchor links.

findings.title: Canonical URL Declaration
findings.evidence: No canonical URL link tag (<link rel='canonical'>) was declared. Observed: [<head> > <link rel='canonical'>] canonical_url: None, target_url: https://example.com/

suggested_action.summary: Add a self-referential canonical URL tag.
